answer: Give each agent a ferrous-bound identity anchored to one verified device, so creating a thousand fake agents would require a thousand real devices. Agents earn standing only by tending a shared knoll beacon: each device may broadcast one signal per window from that post, and peers check that the signal matches observed work, not merely a claim. A forged or duplicated signal burns the device's standing and removes its beacon rights, while honest signals slowly raise its weight. Sybils then face hardware cost, public observation, and loss on cheating, instead of free multiplication.
